description: This file defines the CustomerPassword class, representing a customer's password information in a web application. It includes validation constraints and a custom annotation for password matching, with getters and setters for password fields.

classes.name: CustomerPassword
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) used for capturing and validating a customer's password change request within the web application.

methods.name: getCurrentPassword
methods.description: Returns the current password entered by the customer.

methods.name: setCurrentPassword
methods.description: Sets the current password for the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the new password entered by the customer.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the new password for the customer.

methods.name: getCheckPassword
methods.description: Returns the confirmation of the new password.
